CustomField.description: When the last large parent run started, written under the run lock. A new run waits until the Large Parent Hours setting has passed since then, so a parent with very many records is recalculated at most that often and the saves in between share one run (D-200 P2).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Used by BarnCRM to space out large parent runs.
CustomField.label: Last Run Started
